title: Ok, but flat, not a globe shape, and very heavy
text:
Ok, but flat, not a globe shape, and very heavy. When I saw this one, I thought it was going to be a round ornament. It even says "globe" in its own description.
It is not.

The ornament is a flat disc.
The Santa/reindeer are molded shape, like a pour mold. The ornament is surprisingly heavy for what it is. It comes with an attached red ribbon for hanging. You'll need a larger tree, because the weight would topple a little or tabletop sized tree. You could always hang this from a standalone ornament hanger as well.

Overall, not what I thought it would be, but it's cute enough.
